source: Overture Maps Foundation 2026-07-22.0 (ODbL; OSM + Google + Microsoft, GERS-deduplicated) | heights: Google Open Buildings 2.5D Temporal (2023) via Earth Engine
heightsNote: Heights: zonal p65 of Open Buildings 2.5D Temporal (2023 epoch, ~4 m) per Overture footprint. Method chosen against OSM building:levels -- verdict UNDERPOWERED at 6 matched pairs, so p65 ships as the statistic measured to sit where the previous values sat; the set is not independently validated. 2.5 m is Google's no-confident-height fill AND the raster floor; 438 buildings sit on it, either unmeasured or reading below Google's published minimum.
